description.narrative: Genetic markers allow us to understand relatedness of elephant populations, and are essential to identify the provenance of confiscated illegal ivory. title.narrative: COMBATING ILLEGAL CHEETAH TRAFFICKING: AN ADAPTIVE MANAGEMENT STRATEGY FOR BUILDING REGIONAL AND NATIONAL CAPACITY IN THE HORN OF AFRICA

description.narrative: AN ESTIMATED 7,000 WILD CHEETAHS (ACINONYX JUBATUS) REMAIN ON THE AFRICAN CONTINENT, OCCUPYING ONLY 13% OF THEIR FORMER RANGE. HUMAN-WILDLIFE CONFLICTS, HABITAT LOSS AND FRAGMENTATION, LOSS OF PREY DUE TO GRAZING COMPETITION, AND THE TRADE OF SKINS AND LIVE ANIMALS ARE A DIRECT THREAT TO WILD CHEETAH POPULATIONS.
